items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals negative open; Asia markets rise, Adani Group stocks in focus
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Tuesday: The GIFT Nifty signalled a negative open for the Nifty50. Most Asian markets were trading higher

items.title: Stocks to buy today: Avalon Technologies, Healthcare Global; check targets
items.description: Anand James of Geojit Investments has recommended two stocks to buy today - Avalon Technologies and Healthcare Global Enterprises.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Vi, Lupin, Zen Tech, BSE, Wipro, Adani Group stocks
items.description: Siemens, Zydus Lifesciences, Bata India, Caliber Mining And Logistics, Delta Corp are among companies reporting earnings today.

items.title: Kotak Securities' top trading bets: Narayana Hrudayalaya, Mrs Bectors Food
items.description: Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Securities has recommended Narayana Hrudayalaya and Mrs Bectors Food Specialities as top picks for today.

items.title: Adani group stocks jump up to 3% on US court relief for Gautam Adani
items.description: Brooklyn-based US District Judge Nicholas Garaufis dismissed conspiracy, securities and wire fraud charges brought against them in a late-night order, marking an end to Adani's US legal troubles.

items.title: ZEEL drops 5% as weak ad revenue drags Q1 profit by 48%; should you buy?
items.description: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services said ZEEL delivered another subdued quarter. The firm's consolidated profit in Q1 declined by 48.3 per cent to ₹74.3 crore.

items.title: Gland Pharma rallies 12%, hits 4-year high; should you buy, hold or sell?
items.description: Gland Pharma Share: The market price of Gland Pharma hit a high of ₹2,989.2 in intra-day deals on Tuesday. The stock bounced back 90 per cent from its 52-week low of ₹1,575 touched on March 16, 2026.

items.title: Kolte-Patil shares zoom 19% to hit fresh 52-wk high after Q1 turnaround
items.description: Kolte Patil Developers' net profit was ₹146.3 crore for the first quarter of FY27, compared with a loss of ₹17 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.title: MF schemes with 10%+ gains fall by 3/4th in FY26; is easy money era over?
items.description: Sebi's annual report for financial year 2025-26 (FY26) shows that 198 schemes delivered 10 per cent-plus gains in the last fiscal year, as against 304 in FY25 and a whopping 822 in FY24.

items.title: HDFC Bank stock hits 2-year low, tanks 12% in one month
items.description: HDFC Bank stock: Thus far in the calendar year 2026, HDFC Bank underperformed the market by falling 27 per cent, compared to a 8.2 per cent decline in the BSE Sensex.

items.title: OFS forms 61% of ₹2.3trn IPO proceeds in 1.5 yrs; why're promoters selling?
items.description: In 2025 alone, 113 issues raised around ₹1.7 trillion, of which October was the biggest month, with 10 IPOs raising ₹45,188 crore, including a massive ₹35,441 crore through OFS.

items.title: Wipro's exit from Nifty 50 reflects waning clout of Indian IT giants
items.description: The combined weight of India's top five IT companies in the Nifty 50 has fallen below 9% this year, the lowest at least since 2002

items.title: Triveni Turbine shares tumble 8% after Q1 profit drops 20%, margins shrink
items.description: Triveni Turbine has reported a net profit of ₹51.1 crore in Q1FY27, down 20 per cent from ₹64.4 crore posted in the year-ago period.

items.title: Lumax Auto zooms 20% on robust Q1 results; hits new high in weak market
items.description: Lumax Auto says, ongoing premiumization of vehicles, rising adoption of advanced technologies and increasing content per vehicle continue to create significant opportunities for auto component makers.
